high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account @theprimefact. The post features a black-and-white photograph of a building with the word "Samsung" prominently displayed at the top. Below the name, there is Japanese text on a banner that reads "株式会社三星商会," which translates to "Samsung Corporation." The year "1938" is overlaid on the image, indicating the historical context of the photo. The scene appears to be from a street view, showing a traditional building with a flat roof and a signboard. There are people walking and some horse-drawn carriages parked outside,
